messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Repulsion-based force model with triangle-area potential

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The global optimum for 13 points in the unit square under minimum triangle area maximization is a 'double-lattice' configuration: a 3x4 rectangular grid (with coordinates (i/3, j/2) for i,j integers) offset and interlaced with its dual lattice (coordinates ((i+0.5)/3, (j+0.5)/2)), giving 12 lattice points plus one center point, achieving a minimum triangle area of 1/24. This structure arises as the unique stable equilibrium of a repulsion potential where every point pair (i,j) exerts a force proportional to the reciprocal of the minimum triangle area over all third points k, forcing co-circular triples and collinear lattice rows to maximize the smallest areas."}
